statement: The original retail Switch Pro controller's exact USB descriptor, HID collection/report declaration bytes, firmware revisions and USB enumeration topology are not authenticated by the three cited software implementations.

applicability.revision: source revisions Linux 4056b3c, SDL 535d80b, OpenPuck 29f4d1e; physical device revision unmeasured
applicability.scope: No physical USB descriptor/GET dump; do not adopt OpenPuck's synthesized descriptor as retail evidence.
